profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Toyota Connected North America
profile.summary: Electrical engineer with experience in both embedded and application layer software. I enjoy being involved in all layers of product development, from working with hardware to developing applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Hybrid Network Security Solution
▪ Develop AWS-based Java microservices in an Agile development environment including:
- Account management
- Tenant separation for multi-tenant applications
- Feature flag support to help control customer preview access and GA releases
- Ability to inspect customer infrastructure to ensure compatibility with network security product
▪ Coordinate with cross-functional teams using JIRA to ensure cohesive product outcomes
▪ Present key product milestones to senior management
▪ Actively maintain code quality using best practices such as code reviews and unit testing

Hardware to Cloud Proof-of-Concept
▪ Created C++ based websocket application to communicate with web application microservices
▪ Designed and implemented architecture for handling long-running asynchronous tasks such as software
upgrades and Technical Service Report uploads

positions.title: Platform Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained various Linux applications and drivers for Intrusion Prevention System (IPS)
Upgraded and maintained Linux distribution through Yocto
Ported application software across multiple kernel upgrades
Introduced unit testing to legacy applications to improve robustness and maintainability
Wrote system level tests in Python

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed embedded and application layer software for key company product
Performed exploratory research into integrating new technologies
Led efforts to redesign music streaming interface
Integrated Zigbee radio for home automation
Acted as project lead to integrate Alexa Voice Services from Amazon
Participated in numerous design and code reviews

positions.title: Applications Engineer
positions.description:
Isolated root cause and debugged various hardware and software customer issues 
Developed and integrated software bug fixes in Linux and Windows CE BSP releases 
Assisted customers with software migration and programming for manufacturing 
Lead reviews of customer schematic designs with an eye towards software impact  
Performed preliminary benchmarking measurements to record baseline numbers 
Created documentation to leverage existing knowledge for frequently asked questions 
Managed inter-company relationship with Timesys with weekly conference calls

positions.title: SQA Intern
positions.description:
Developed and maintained test cases for Bluetooth software
Discovered and reported driver bugs and defects
Use debugging skills to isolate root cause defects
Bridged communication gap between Broadcom and HP through weekly status reports
